typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'PR_LARX_Prior_Auth_Weekly_Extract',
	schemaName: 'LAExtracts',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> Pharmacy
Pharmacy derive({Copy of ResultSet} = ResultSet) ~> DataConversionRX
DataConversionRX sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet = {Copy of ResultSet})) ~> PharmacyFlatFile
